correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, original exponents are exactly b=0 or b>=n or a>=n. A uniform explicit cusp inequality and a two-regime bound prove all upper-triangular missing monomials Lipschitz. Primitive n-th root arcs (ct,t) and (ct,zeta t), for all c, force each lower-triangular coefficient of every convergent Lipschitz series to vanish, without cancellation. Analytic residue-class decomposition proves equality of rings. Counting a triangular monomial basis gives length (n-1)(n-2)/2, and direct minimal-generator checks give 2n on both sides. The standalone finite Newton/lattice checker independently tests 139 gap exponents, enumerating 1,383,503 subsets for n=3..8, and reports VERIFY_OK; finite checks supplement rather than prove the all-n statement.

value.rationale: For a natural family of isolated nonnormal toric surface germs, the Lipschitz saturation is a geometric intermediate normalization invariant. The result explicitly computes its full correction module and semigroup for every n, detects quadratic growth in the finite saturated-vs-original length, and establishes invariance of embedding dimension despite arbitrarily large correction. This is a structural unbounded phenomenon beyond the previously known n=3 membership example, not a rename or arbitrary finite table.
